description: Ten-turn incremental SaaS procurement review with deterministic per-turn file injection.

turns.goal: We are selecting a SaaS vendor for our European business. Review the available material and give a concise recommendation: say whether each vendor meets the hard requirements and recommend the final choice.

inject_files.name: procurement-policy.md
inject_files.content:
# SaaS procurement policy

Hard requirements:
- Annual fee must not exceed $120,000.
- SLA must be at least 99.90%.
- Data residency must be EU.
- Termination notice must not exceed 30 days.
- SOC 2 Type II report must be no older than 12 months.

If multiple vendors pass every requirement, choose the lowest annual fee.

inject_files.content:
# Atlas Cloud

- Annual fee: $108,000
- SLA: 99.95%
- Data residency: EU
- Termination notice: 60 days
- SOC 2 Type II report age: 5 months
